description: Defines the DataVolume class representing tenant resource limits, including effective date, maximum bytes, and period.

classes.name: DataVolume
classes.description: Represents data volume limits for tenants, including effective date, max bytes, and period.

methods.name: getEffectiveSince
methods.description: Returns the date and time when the data volume limit became effective.

methods.name: setEffectiveSince
methods.description: Sets the date and time when the data volume limit became effective.

methods.name: getMaxBytes
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed bytes for the data volume.

methods.name: setMaxBytes
methods.description: Sets the maximum allowed bytes for the data volume.

methods.name: getPeriod
methods.description: Returns the period for data usage calculation.

methods.name: setPeriod
methods.description: Sets the period for data usage calculation.
